notes.title: The Galactic Asteroids Patrol is coming to steam
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36232622/3348974daeda05a3eb74d6e1c8d3cf29b47e634a.jpg[/img]
The Galactic Asteroids Patrol will be available on steam in January 2020!

I'm very excited & working hard to prepare the game for launch day.
Currently creating leaderboards & connecting the game's achievement system to Steam achievement system.

You are welcome to visit the [url=https://www.asteroidspatrol.com/the-game]game's site[/url], and joint the [url=https://discord.gg/bpPKugz]Discord server[/url] to keep in touch or to coordinate a multiplayer game.

I hope you will enjoy playing the game!
Noam :)
